title: Align Unity bone-weight contract with binding builder
description: `SkinnedMeshBindingBuilder.BuildBoneWeights` documents itself as enforcing the same safety contract as `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform`, but its current validation only requires finite non-negative weights with a positive total. It does not enforce Unity's documented `BoneWeight` contract that the four weights sum to 1 and are ordered descending. The current production authoring path (`ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring.Author`) already normalizes and sorts its selected influences, so this is primarily a boundary-contract and future-caller hardening issue rather than a proven current generated-creature defect. Define the owning contract explicitly and make the Unity adapter either normalize/reorder or reject invalid totals/order, with parity tests covering partial totals, descending-order violations, zero-filled unused slots, duplicate indices, and the existing normalized production path.
